modules.title: “查询明天下午”从工具请求到日历结果
工具请求怎样变成真实结果

items.title: 根据工具定义发起调用请求
items.text: 工具由名称、功能说明与参数格式定义。模型根据用户需求填入参数发起 tool call，但这只是发出调用请求，模型并未直接操作外部系统。

items.title: 产品先校验权限与参数
items.text: 产品检查工具是否允许、参数是否合理，以及当前用户有没有执行权限。

items.title: 执行后的真实结果再返回模型
items.text: 只有外部工具执行后的真实数据才会带回模型，由模型整理成最终给用户的回答。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 参数长得像数据也不能直接执行；删除、发送等动作仍应检查范围和确认。

lessonPractice.title: Agent 说“已经创建日历会议”，但还没有执行日历工具。此时最准确的状态是什么？

options.label: 它只提出了工具调用请求；应用执行并返回结果后才能说会议已创建
options.feedback: 对。模型选择工具不等于外部操作已经发生。

options.label: 模型写出了会议标题，就可视为会议已经存在
options.feedback: 文字和真实日历状态是两件事。

options.label: 直接告诉用户成功，不必等待工具的返回
options.feedback: 工具可能失败、被拒绝或创建了不同结果，必须依据真实返回确认。

en.title: An agent says a calendar meeting is created but has not run the calendar tool. What is the accurate state?

options.label: It has only requested a tool call; claim creation only after the app executes it and returns a result
options.feedback: Correct. Choosing a tool is not the same as an external action occurring.

options.label: A meeting title in model text means the meeting exists
options.feedback: Text and real calendar state are different things.

options.label: Tell the user it worked without waiting for the tool response
options.feedback: The tool may fail, be denied, or create a different result; confirm from its real return.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先用 mock 日历或专用测试日历验证创建流程，不要写入真实日程。调用前展示时间、参会人和标题；分别模拟创建成功与权限拒绝，并按工具真实返回报告结果。若测试日历确实生成了事件，结束后删除它。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Validate meeting creation with a mock or dedicated test calendar, not a real schedule. Show the proposed time, attendees, and title before the call; simulate one success and one permission denial, reporting only from the actual tool result. Delete any event created in the test calendar afterward.

learning.assumes: You have used a chat assistant that can look up calendars, files, or orders.
learning.outcome: You can explain that a tool call is a request, not a completed external action.

modules.title: From “check tomorrow afternoon” to a calendar result
How a tool request becomes a real result

items.title: Request execution based on tool definitions
items.text: Tools are defined with a name, description, and typed parameters. The model fills parameters to request a tool call, but this is only an invocation request—the model does not run the tool directly.

items.title: The application validates permissions and parameters
items.text: It checks whether the tool is permitted, whether parameters make sense, and whether the user has access.

items.title: Real execution results return to the model
items.text: Only the executed result from the external tool comes back to the model to formulate the final answer.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Data-shaped parameters are not permission to act. Delete and send actions still need scope checks and confirmation.
